# Choose a reference point

<!-- STEP id="origin" -->
To describe where something is, first choose a fixed point, the **reference point**. Here the athlete's starting point is our reference point.

<!-- STEP id="position" -->
Draw the track as a straight line with distances marked. The reference point O is the origin, at 0 m. The **position** of the athlete is her distance and direction from O at that instant.
